transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. Lately I just don’t care about the art shows, the mentoring, or even my photography anymore; nothing feels worth doing. My wife got deeply worried when I completely withdrew from everything, which is why she urged me to come speak with you.
Have you had any times when you heard voices, saw things that others could not, or felt strongly convinced of things that other people said were not true?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices or seen things that weren't there, nor have I held any beliefs that others told me were untrue.

How much has this loss of interest and withdrawal affected your daily life, such as work, relationships, and basic self-care? Have you been able to keep up with these activities at all, or have they become nearly impossible?

It’s become nearly impossible to keep up with anything, and I’ve had to back out of my mentoring commitments and even missed the major exhibition opening I spent months organizing. My wife has had to take over almost all of our household tasks because I just can't manage simple responsibilities right now. Most days I just sit in my chair, letting emails and invitations pile up completely unanswered.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling sad, down, or hopeless most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I've felt completely down and hopeless nearly every day, often just sitting in the dark because I can't see the point of anything anymore. I feel like a useless fraud, and this heavy, joyless feeling has been hanging over me for months now.
How long have you been feeling this depressed and hopeless nearly every day—has it lasted at least two weeks, or longer?

It has been much longer than two weeks. This heavy, joyless phase has been hanging over me for most of the past year, probably about five months now of feeling completely empty every single day. It just doesn't seem to lift.
Have you had any thoughts that others might consider untrue, such as believing you are being punished, that you have special powers, or that your thoughts are being controlled?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't feel like I'm being punished, and I certainly don't believe I have any special powers or that anyone else is controlling my thoughts.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, such as trouble falling asleep, waking up very early, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yes, my sleep has been terrible lately. I often lie awake until two or three in the morning with my mind spinning, and then I wake up before dawn feeling completely wrung out. Even if I've technically been in bed for eight hours, it feels like I haven't slept at all.
During this depression, have you ever felt that you were hearing voices, seeing things others could not, or believed things that others said were not true?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that during this depression. I haven't heard any voices, seen things that aren't there, or held any unusual beliefs.
